fullDescription: Premium dark-mode editorial tech design with high-contrast cream typography and a bold orange accent. Features a complex 16-column responsive grid, precision dashed-line UI elements, and sophisticated scroll-triggered reveals. Suitable for high-end consumer hardware, AI startups, premium lifestyle brands, and digital product portfolios.
prompt:
## Resumo
A sophisticated, dark-themed tech-lifestyle interface that blends minimalist editorial design with heavy focus on precision. The design uses large-scale typography, a custom grid system, and interactive 'flipper' text elements. It relies on a palette of deep coffee-blacks, creams, and vibrant orange, complemented by subtle monochromatic dashed borders and technical iconography.

## Estilo Visual
Color Palette: Background primary `#100904` (deep black-brown), text primary `#ffedd7` (soft cream), accent `#dc5000` (vibrant orange), secondary `#6c5f51` (grey-brown), sustainability accents `#445231` (deep green). 
Typography: Headers use a medium-weight sans-serif (Medium 500) with line-heights ranging from `0.9` for H1 to `1.2`. Sizes are dynamically scaled based on screen width (`--screen-unit`). H1 at `164px` scale, H2 at `68px`. Editorial 'Magazine' sections use a light-weight Serif (`Literata`). Technical readouts use Monospace (`DM Mono`). 
UI Elements: Borders and separators use `1px` dashed lines created via `repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #ffedd7 0 2px, transparent 0 4px)`. Buttons are pill-shaped with significant padding (`1.2em 2em`) and uppercase text. 
Transitions: Hover states for text use a 'flipper' effect where characters shift vertically within a clipped container. Hover curves are generally `ease-in-out` with durations of `0.18s` to `0.25s`.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Fixed Header
Fixed header pinned to site padding. Logo on the far left. Navigation menu on the far right using a horizontal list with `2em` gaps. An active indicator line (`1px` dashed) slides horizontally underneath the active nav item. On mobile, the header collapses into a pill-shaped button with a dashed border labeled 'Menu'.

### Hero Section
Full viewport height. Headline text is justified and massive. Copy blocks are positioned precisely using grid spans (e.g., span-10 start). Bottom-left corner contains a feature card with dashed line separators. Bottom-right contains a 16:9 video thumbnail with a glowing orange inner border (`box-shadow: inset 0 0 8px 4px #e07010`) and a 'PLAY' button overlay.

### Feature Grid Reveal
Features are presented in a series of reveal animations. Each feature includes a custom icon inside a semi-transparent circular background (`fill-opacity: 0.2`). Content is split between a right-aligned large H3 title and a left-aligned body text block. Dashed lines animate their width from `0%` to `100%` on reveal.

### Technical Interactive Sections
Includes an 'Encryption' input field with a dashed-line frame that pulses opacity. A 'Grip' section features a zoom-box that tracks mouse movement, displaying estimated friction coefficients as numerical data (`0.80`) over a solid cream background block.

### Sustainability Bento
A grid of tinted green cards (`#f6e0c6` and `#445231`). Includes large, centered numerical values used as background elements. Cards feature Rive or SVG animations of harvesting cycles and rotating text.

### Editorial Comparison Table
Centered table spanning 14 columns. Alternating rows have semi-transparent backgrounds with highly rounded corners (`radius: 3em`). Column headers include an 'Orange H5' sub-label ('New') above a bold H4 product name. Cell content includes detailed spec lists with half-opacity cream text.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Flipper Button — Interactive text that performs a vertical rotation/flip on hover.
Container with `overflow: hidden`. Text is duplicated into two spans. On hover, the primary span translates `3D(0, -100%, 0)` while the secondary span (initially hidden below) moves into the visible area. Used for all primary CTA links and nav items.

### Video Overlay System — A cinematic video player with custom cursor and glow effects.
Fixed overlay with `#000000e6` background. Player has `2.5rem` border-radius and a dual-layer orange glow: one outer (`0 0 60px 45px #e6500a40`) and one inner (`inset 0 0 45px 20px #e6500a59`). Custom cursor is a white circle that scales from 0 to 1, showing 'Play/Pause' SVG icons based on video state.

### Social Progress Bar — A segmented progress indicator for carousel content.
Horizontal bar composed of multiple `2px` high segments. Muted segments use `#6c5f51`. The active segment uses `#dc5000` and expands its `flex-grow` value from 1 to 3 to indicate current position.
